column1: # Key of ASF Mediceo del Principato 384 c. 76r, learnt ONLY on lines L01-L13 aligned with the contemporary decipherment c. 79r (9 Nov 2026, Brice Dudout with Claude).
# Rule: an output kept if seen >= 2 times and >= 20% of the occurrences of the code. Prefix code: 6, 8, 9 alone = e, o, a; every other code is two digits.
# Dotted variants (a dot over either digit) carry the same value and are folded here. Codes not seen twice in L01-L13 are absent (rare homophones, nomenclature).
# Partial by our protocol: held-out L14-L18, character agreement 0.695 vs best of 200 shuffled keys 0.218 (validated would be >= 0.85).
